title: Restore public-route replay coverage for retained bare-proxy native relay pins
outcome: A public send regression proves that a pre-existing native relay pin whose requested target is a bare proxy retains its original outcome after the new bare-proxy initiation refusal, even when the projection is localized or removed.
acceptance: A public-route regression starts with a retained relay pin whose requested_target is the original bare proxy id, changes or removes the projection, and verifies exact duplicate receipt identity with no second canonical append or local native message.
The test distinguishes new bare-proxy initiation refusal from immutable old-pin replay and removes or updates vestigial proxy setup in the current host-qualified send test.
